title: ModelDocViewStyle DetailViewStyle group-3 resource-reference insertion fast slice
scope: Serialize a changed DetailViewStyle view-label text-style reference when the captured source has no group-3 group-340 field.
Exercise insertion into a missing style group while preserving ordered groups and aligned ASCII/Binary raw values.
Verify same-version typed ASCII and Binary readback without adding repository fixtures or a CTest registration.

implementation.behavior: The copied DetailViewStyle raw carrier inserts group 340 in style group 3 when the typed view-label text-style handle differs from the class default and no source group represented it. Hex handle formatting is checked; zero and sentinel handles are refused. ASCII raw lexemes and Binary placeholders remain aligned, and the raw-object writer applies its existing source-handle remapping.
implementation.generatedControl: The secondary DetailViewStyle omits its entire group-3 block. The test confirms the imported typed handle is zero, edits it to the existing VIEW_STYLE_TEXT style, verifies the expected ordered raw stream in ASCII and Binary, and confirms typed readback resolves the reference to that style. The same control also covers the adjacent group-2 absent boundary-line reference slice.

limitations: Only same-version DXF serialization of this optional single-reference field is covered.
Other absent fields and changed repeated-reference cardinality remain fail-closed.
No DWG-origin typed output, cross-version translation, native style rendering, or consumer support qualification follows.
